The story follows a completely traditional and conventional form and structure. It is written as a standard, linear, retrospective first-person narrative. It progresses chronologically through a single year—from the narrator moving into the house, through the rising romantic and interpersonal tensions, to a climax/revelation in the spring, and finally a quiet resolution and reflection as she moves out at the end of the summer.
